_readme: The independent variable: the SET OF MODELS compared on the dgx (sglang/GB10) platform. Edit this to the models you actually serve. Each entry is the whole model bundle under test -- weights, quantization, its own vendor-recommended sampling, and its native context window (VISION.md: 'A model is compared as its out-of-the-box, best-native self'). 'id' is the short label used in trial ids and results grouping; 'served_model' is the id the server reports at /v1/models and the agent selects; 'model_path' is the checkpoint preflight verifies is live. sglang serves ONE model per instance, so run one model's batch at a time (make run-all MODEL=<id>) relaunching the server between them, or list only the currently-served model here. Omit a sampling key a model has no recommendation for. The first entry is the model compare-agents/compare-platform pinned; the rest are illustrative -- replace them.
